title: UI风格#117 - Brutalist Noir (粗野黑色电影)
description: 创建第117种UI风格：粗野黑色电影风格 - 黑色电影与粗野主义结合、戏剧性与力量感。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planDM.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Noir style When color palette Then features deep black, harsh white, blood red, concrete gray
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#0D0D0D (深黑), #FFFFFF (白), #8B0000 (血红), #4A4A4A (混凝土), #1C1C1C (炭黑)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Noir style When typography Then uses bold noir: Bebas Neue, Roboto Mono, or Share Tech Mono
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Bebas Neue (粗体), Roboto Mono (正文), Share Tech Mono (替代)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Noir style When layout Then harsh contrasts, concrete frames, dramatic shadows, brutal geometry
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：强烈对比、混凝土框架、戏剧性阴影、粗野几何

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Noir style When UI elements Then film noir lighting, concrete textures, blood red accents
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：黑色电影光照、混凝土质感、血红点缀、硬边过渡

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Noir UI When functional Then includes detective chat, noir agents, case stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：侦探聊天、黑色代理、案件统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Brutalist Noir UI When copy Then uses detective noir: 'Case', 'Shadow', 'Evidence', 'Witness'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'CASE. SHADOW. EVIDENCE.'、按钮'SEND'→'INVESTIGATE'、'SUBMIT'→'PROSECUTE'
